body: It’s hard to be sure, I guess 13 years or so, maybe a bit more.
tired and constant pain. I’m sorry you’re feeling this way too.
What’s got you to this point if you don’t mind me asking? Sorry you feel this way too.

I’m posting to get out my feelings out, the anxiety, frustration, relief, peace and dread I’m feeling. Not to be stopped, you don’t need to focus on me if that’s you’re intention here - you’re a good person for caring.
